def g(a,b,x):
    t=(a+b+x)&0xff
    return ((t<<2)|(t>>6))&0xff

#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Differential attack against the FEAL-like cipher in feal.py.
#
# The F function has the deterministic differential
#     0x80800000  ->  0x02000000
# (input bytes 2 and 3 differ in their high bit).  Choose plaintext
# differences so that, after the pre-round mixing, the round-0 input
# difference is (0x02000000, 0x80800000).  Propagating through rounds
# 0, 1 and 2 then deterministically gives the last round an input
# difference (0x80800000, 0x02000000).  Therefore the ciphertexts of
# such a pair satisfy
#
#     F(R3a ^ k5) ^ F(R3b ^ k5) ^ 0x80800000 == upper_diff
#
# where R3 = L4 = upper ^ lower of the ciphertext.  Testing this for
# all 2^16 possible seeds of k5 recovers the key with a few pairs.

A = 0x80800000
B = 0x02000000
DELTA = ((B & 0xFFFFFFFF) << 32) | ((A ^ B) & 0xFFFFFFFF)


def _g(a, b, x):
    t = (a + b + x) & 0xFF
    return ((t << 2) | (t >> 6)) & 0xFF


def _f(v):
    x0 = v & 0xFF
    x1 = (v >> 8) & 0xFF
    x2 = (v >> 16) & 0xFF
    x3 = (v >> 24) & 0xFF

    y2 = _g(x3 ^ x2, x1 ^ x0, 1)
    y3 = _g(x3, y2, 0)
    y1 = _g(x1 ^ x0, y2, 0)
    y0 = _g(x0, y1, 1)

    return y0 | (y1 << 8) | (y2 << 16) | (y3 << 24)


def attack(encrypt_fn):
    candidates = [((s * 1234567) & 0xFFFFFFFF) for s in range(0x10000)]

    base = 0x0123456789ABCDEF
    step = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15
    p = base

    for _ in range(16):
        p = (p + step) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        q = p ^ DELTA

        c1 = encrypt_fn(p)
        c2 = encrypt_fn(q)

        u1 = (c1 >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        l1 = c1 & 0xFFFFFFFF
        u2 = (c2 >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        l2 = c2 & 0xFFFFFFFF

        d_upper = u1 ^ u2
        d_lower = l1 ^ l2

        if (d_upper ^ d_lower) != B:
            continue

        r3a = u1 ^ l1
        r3b = u2 ^ l2

        survivors = []
        for k in candidates:
            if (_f(r3a ^ k) ^ _f(r3b ^ k) ^ A) == d_upper:
                survivors.append(k)

        candidates = survivors
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            return candidates[0]
        if not candidates:
            break

    return candidates[0] if candidates else 0
